# get_llm_tool_tool

> Get details of a specific custom LLM Tool by ID or name.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `llm_tools` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=get_llm_tool_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Get details of a specific custom LLM Tool by ID or name.

Returns full tool details: metadata, input schema, JavaScript call_block code,
configuration fields, and agent associations.

EXAMPLES:
Get by ID: {id: 123}
Get by name: {name: "custom_fetch"}
Get without agent list: {name: "custom_fetch", include_agents: false}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | no | Tool ID (use id OR name) |
| `name` | string | no | Tool name (use id OR name) |
| `include_agents` | boolean | no | Include list of agents using this tool (default: true) |
